analyst_view.overall: Dinamo Zagreb (9th, 7 points) host Bayer Leverkusen (7th, 9 points) at the Maksimir, both chasing a top-eight place. Dinamo have won all their games under Jerko Leko; captain Josip Misic was a doubt after a knock against Istra, but Germanijak reports he trained on Tuesday without problems, while local press debates how much to rotate with league games against Gorica and Rijeka close behind. Scott McKenna and Robert Mudrazija are in the numbers' missing list. Leverkusen come off two league wins and go to Dortmund on Sunday, with Martin Terrier, Kennet Eichhorn and Guela Doue out, all counted. Ukrainian referee Mykola Balakin shows few cards, which the numbers already take off; with no new absence the numbers miss, I stay with them on every stat.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.2 goals, 2.1 of them for Leverkusen. Misic now looks fit, McKenna's long absence is in the missing list and already shows in Dinamo's recent record, and Leverkusen's forwards are close to full strength apart from Terrier, so I stay at about 3.2.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.9 corners, 6.4 for Leverkusen, who have won a lot of corners lately (already counted, +1.5%). Leverkusen should have most of the ball while Leko's Dinamo play direct and quick in transition, the pattern their recent games already show, so I stay at about 9.9.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.4 cards and already take 18% off for referee Mykola Balakin, who averages 2.8 a game and has been criticised at home for letting a dangerous tackle go. The Maksimir crowd can raise the temperature, but that is part of Dinamo's home record, so I stay at about 3.4.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.9 shots and already lift Leverkusen for heavy recent shooting (+6.2%). Both sides may manage minutes with league games right after, but neither has announced changes that would clearly move the total, so I stay at about 27.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.0 on target and already lift Leverkusen (+6.7%) after 45 on target in their last six. With the absences on both sides already in the missing list and Misic fit, I stay at about 10.
